# Vendored: Flux

- Project: https://github.com/kohltastrophe/flux
- Documentation: https://flux.kohl.gg
- Version: **v0.5.2** (git tag `v0.5.2`, commit `1a2ae9a332cef3f82ad311e743bc08614d5ae21b`)
- License: MIT, see [`LICENSE.md`](LICENSE.md) (kept intact, and also bundled into `ui.rbxm` as `Licenses/Flux`).

`src/` is an **unmodified** copy of the upstream `src/` directory at that tag. To update, replace the folder
with the new upstream `src/`, bump the version above, and rebuild `ui.rbxm` (see the root README).
